panel.title: Ingested Volume by Sourcetype & Vendor TA Normalization

search.query: index IN (idx_network_ops, idx_security_fw, idx_wireless_ops, idx_performance_metrics, netops_logs, cisco_mdt_metrics, cisco_metrics, sdwan, cisco_secure_fw, main) index=$selected_index$ | stats count as "Event Count", dc(host) as "Host Count", latest(_time) as "Last Ingested" by index, sourcetype | eval "Target Index Class" = if(index=="idx_performance_metrics" OR index=="cisco_mdt_metrics" OR index=="cisco_metrics", "Metrics / Telemetry", "Standard Events") | eval "Installed Technical Add-on" = case( like(sourcetype, "%pan:%") OR like(sourcetype, "%paloalto%"), "Palo Alto Networks (Splunk_TA_paloalto_networks)", like(sourcetype, "%fortinet%") OR like(sourcetype, "%fortigate%"), "Fortinet FortiGate (Splunk_TA_fortinet_fortigate)", like(sourcetype, "%juniper%") OR like(sourcetype, "%junos%"), "Juniper Networks (Splunk_TA_juniper)", like(sourcetype, "%arista%"), "Arista EOS Telemetry (aristanetworks)", like(sourcetype, "%nokia%") OR like(sourcetype, "%sros%"), "Nokia SR OS Architecture Profile", like(sourcetype, "%zscaler%"), "Zscaler Cloud SASE (TA-Zscaler_CIM)", like(sourcetype, "%netskope%"), "Netskope Security Cloud (TA-NetSkopeAppForSplunk)", like(sourcetype, "%aruba%"), "Aruba Networks Wireless (TA-aruba_networks)", like(sourcetype, "%f5%") OR like(sourcetype, "%bigip%"), "F5 BIG-IP ADC (Splunk_TA_f5-bigip)", like(sourcetype, "%meraki%"), "Cisco Meraki Dashboard (Splunk_TA_cisco_meraki)", like(sourcetype, "%sdwan%"), "Cisco SD-WAN (TA-cisco_sdwan)", like(sourcetype, "%cisco%"), "Cisco Enterprise (TA-cisco / Cisco MDT)", 1=1, "Generic Multi-Vendor Ingestion" ) | fieldformat "Last Ingested" = strftime('Last Ingested', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -"Event Count"

panel.title: Live Telemetry Event Feed (Latest 20 Ingested Records)

search.query: index IN (idx_network_ops, idx_security_fw, idx_wireless_ops, idx_performance_metrics, netops_logs, cisco_mdt_metrics, cisco_metrics, sdwan, cisco_secure_fw, main) index=$selected_index$ | table _time, index, host, sourcetype, _raw | head 20
| mstats avg(_value) WHERE index=cisco_mdt_metrics metric_name=* BY metric_name span=1m
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as "Metric Names", dc(host) as "Reporting Hosts" WHERE index=cisco_mdt_metrics
